skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: 또 한 번의 가을
skins.content: 테스트 컬렉션 시리즈 - 또 한 번의 가을. 가을 햇살이 은행잎과 함께 그녀의 하얀 드레스 위로 부드럽게 내려앉았습니다. 챙이 넓은 모자를 쓴 샬롯은 고개를 들어 고요한 가을바람을 어루만집니다.
skins.quote: 그녀가 바라는 것은 오직 하나, 당신과 아미야와 함께 이 길을 계속 걸어가는 것이다. 올해도, 내년에도, 앞으로도 계속.

skins.name: 300 Metres Underground
skins.content: Bloodline of Combat Collection/300 Metres Underground. Savage raises her lantern, her suit billowing in the abyss. Deeper in the darkness, graviton accelerators link in a loop, twinkling in unison. They have noticed her arrival.
skins.usage: One of Savage's outfits for crucial moments.
skins.quote: 'Team, get in contact with Amiya and the Doctor—I've found it! We've finally found it!'

skins.name: Secret Family Recipe
skins.content: Rhodes Kitchen Collection/Secret Family Recipe. Savage wore this when making carrot cakes. The hand-knitted sleeves and an apron paired with a cool, breathable inner layer make it feel relaxing and distinctive.
skins.quote: 'Alright, now I'm going to make the frosting! Everyone close your eyes—this is my mom's secret recipe. Doctor, I saw you sneaking a peek just now!'
